pointers.sentence: Since 6.1 the key of a cached page or fragment hashes each value it varies on as a netstring: its length in bytes, a colon, the bytes and a comma (`django/utils/cache.py:_generate_cache_key`, `django/core/cache/utils.py:make_template_fragment_key`).

Since 6.1 the key of a cached page or fragment hashes each value it varies on as a netstring: its length in bytes, a colon, the bytes and a comma (`django/utils/cache.py:_generate_cache_key`, `django/core/cache/utils.py:make_template_fragment_key`).
The cost, the notes say: the first request for a varying page or fragment cached before the upgrade misses (`docs/releases/6.1.txt`).

A page varies on the request headers its response's `"Vary"` names, bar Accept-Language while `USE_I18N` is true (`django/utils/cache.py:learn_cache_key`); a fragment of the `{% cache %}` tag, keyed by `make_template_fragment_key`, on the values it is given.

Since 6.1 `DatabaseCache.get_many` decodes a row's Base64 strictly, refusing any character outside the alphabet; `DatabaseCache.get` reads through it (`django/core/cache/backends/db.py:DatabaseCache.get_many`).
Values Django writes are unaffected, the notes say; a corrupted or non-standard entry may no longer read (`docs/releases/6.1.txt`).

Since 6.2 a write does so only when `random.random()` is at most the alias's `"CULL_PROBABILITY"`, an optimization, the notes say (`docs/releases/6.2.txt`; `django/core/cache/backends/db.py:DatabaseCache._base_set`).

The option is read from `"OPTIONS"`, 0.1 by default, and 0 turns culling off (`django/core/cache/backends/db.py:BaseDatabaseCache.__init__`; [The cache backends](../services/cache-backends.md)).
Since 6.1 `File.__bool__` returns `True` (`django/core/files/base.py:File.__bool__`).

`FieldFile` and `UploadedFile`, with the upload classes under it, keep the old test, so a file field holding no file is still false (`django/db/models/fields/files.py:FieldFile.__bool__`, `django/core/files/uploadedfile.py:UploadedFile.__bool__`; [Files: `File`, `ContentFile` and their helpers](../services/files.md)).

Set true, it keeps a taken name, and `FileSystemStorage._save` opens the file with `os.O_TRUNC` in place of `os.O_EXCL`, so the save replaces the file (`django/core/files/storage/filesystem.py:FileSystemStorage._save`; [File storage: `Storage`, `FileSystemStorage` and `storages`](../services/storage.md)).
It replaced the undocumented attribute OS_OPEN_FLAGS, which 5.1 deprecated and 6.0 removed (`docs/releases/5.1.txt`).

With the group, the coroutine receivers also share one copy of the sender's context, and what they set in it is set in the sender's when they finish (`django/dispatch/dispatcher.py:_restore_context`).
Since 6.1 `asend` awaits its synchronous receivers before it starts the coroutine ones; before, the coroutine ones did not wait for them to return (`django/dispatch/dispatcher.py:Signal.asend`).

Since 6.2 `DjangoJSONEncoder` writes a datetime or a time to the millisecond only when its milliseconds are not zero, and to the second otherwise (`django/core/serializers/json.py:DjangoJSONEncoder.default`).

Since 6.0 the JSON serializer's text ends in a newline even when it is not indented: `serialize("json", [])` is `"[]"` under 5.2.17 and `"[]\n"` under 6.0.8 and later (`django/core/serializers/json.py:Serializer.end_serialization`).

Dumped with natural foreign keys, a relation to it is written as that key, not as the empty tuple 6.0.8 wrote (`django/core/serializers/python.py:Serializer.get_dump_object`, `django/core/serializers/python.py:Serializer.handle_fk_field`).

Since 6.1 the XML deserializer raises `SuspiciousOperation` when a field's text holds an element with content of its own (`django/core/serializers/xml_serializer.py:check_element_type`).

Since 6.1 `DeserializedObject.save` sets each many-to-many relation with `raw=True`, so loaddata's relations send `m2m_changed` with `raw=True`, an argument new in 6.1 (`django/core/serializers/base.py:DeserializedObject.save`; [Fixtures: dumpdata and loaddata](../services/fixtures.md)).
